intro: Arcane Feedback is a rite of passage for Alliance priests in Stormwind City, granted by High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light. Reaching a deeper communion with faith, the priest is instructed in wards designed to counter hostile practitioners of the arcane. It represents the Church's practical defense against raw sorcery and rogue spellcasters.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We were forced to learn some magics to protect us from what is commonly called our greatest enemy: the arcane.
I would teach you a spell to help you defend yourself and your companions from those who would wield such power.
